For test-backend-ops:

$ cmake -B ${BUILD_DIR} ${CMAKE_OPTS} && cmake --build ${BUILD_DIR} -t test-backend-ops -j $(nproc)

$ cmake -B ${BUILD_DIR} ${CMAKE_OPTS} && cmake --build ${BUILD_DIR} -t test-backend-ops -j $(nproc)

"""
